subtitle: דלאלהֵ אלחאירין — The Guide of the Perplexed
author: Moses Maimonides (1138–1204)
intro: Tzur ('rock') is equivocal: the name of a mountain; the name of hard stone like flint; and the name of the quarry-rock from which mineral-stones are cut. From this last sense it was borrowed for the origin and source of a thing — 'look to the rock whence you were hewn… look to Abraham your father' (Isa 51:1–2). And in this sense God is called Tzur, for He is the origin and efficient cause of all besides Himself. Hover a phrase to see its English light up; tap any word for a gloss; dotted words are key terms.

terms.note: Equivocal: (1) a mountain's name, (2) hard stone like flint, (3) the quarry-rock from which stones are cut — then borrowed for a thing's origin and source.

terms.gloss: the origin and source of everything
terms.note: The borrowed sense of tzur: just as quarried stones share the nature of the rock they were cut from, so 'look to the rock whence you were hewn' is glossed by 'look to Abraham your father.'
Why God is called Tzur: He is the origin and efficient cause of everything other than Himself — 'the Rock, His work is perfect' (Deut 32:4).
'And you shall stand upon the rock' (Exod 33:21): lean and rely on the consideration that He is the origin — He is the avenue through which one reaches Him, as in 'behold, there is a place by Me.'

aligned.ja: אלג'ז אלאול · אלפצל אלסאדס עשר — צור
צור אסם משתרך. הו אסם אלג'בל: והכית בצור. והו אסם חג'ר צלב כאלצואן: חרבות צורים.
aligned.en: Tzur is an equivocal noun. It is the name of a mountain: 'and you shall smite the rock' (Exod 17:6). And it is the name of a hard stone like flint: 'knives of flint' (Josh 5:2).

aligned.ja: והו אסם אלמעדן אלד'י תקתטע מנה חג'ארהֵ אלמעאדן: הביטו אל צור חצבתם.
aligned.en: And it is the name of the quarry-rock from which mineral-stones are cut: 'look to the rock whence you were hewn' (Isa 51:1).

pairs.en: And it is the name of the quarry-rock
from which mineral-stones are cut

aligned.ja: ת'ם אסתעיר מן הד'א אלמעני אלאכ'יר הד'א אלאסם לאצל כל שי ומבדאה, ולד'לך קאל בעד קולה הביטו אל צור חצבתם: הביטו אל אברהם אביכם וכו'.
aligned.en: Then, from this last sense, this noun was borrowed for the origin and source of everything; and therefore, after His saying 'look to the rock whence you were hewn,' He said: 'look to Abraham your father' (Isa 51:2), and so on.

aligned.ja: כאנה שרח אן אלצור אלד'י חצבתם מנה הו אברהם אביכם, פאקתפוא את'רה ודינוא בדינה ותכ'לקוא בכ'לקה, אד' טביעהֵ אלמעדן ילזם אן תכון מוג'ודה פי מא אקתטע מנה.
aligned.en: It is as though He explained that the rock from which you were hewn is Abraham your father — so follow in his footsteps, hold to his creed, and form yourselves by his character; for the nature of the quarry must be present in what is cut from it.

aligned.ja: ובחסב הד'א אלמעני אלאכ'יר תסמי אללה תעאלי צור, אד' הו אלמבדא ואלסבב אלפאעל לכל מא סואה. וקיל: הצור תמים פעלו, צור ילדך תשי, צורם מכרם, ואין צור כאלהינו, צור עולמים.
aligned.en: And according to this last sense God, may He be exalted, is called Tzur, since He is the origin and the efficient cause of all besides Himself. And it is said: 'the Rock, His work is perfect' (Deut 32:4); 'the Rock that begot you, you neglected' (Deut 32:18); 'their Rock had sold them' (Deut 32:30); 'neither is there any rock like our God' (1 Sam 2:2); 'the Rock of ages' (Isa 26:4).

aligned.ja: ונצבת על הצור — אעתמד ואת'בת עלי אעתבאר כונה תעאלי מבדאא, פהו אלמדכ'ל אלד'י תצל מנה אליה, כמא בינא פי קולה לה: הנה מקום אתי.
aligned.en: 'And you shall stand upon the rock' (Exod 33:21) — lean and stand firm upon the consideration that He, may He be exalted, is the origin; for He is the point of access through which one reaches Him, as we explained in His saying to him: 'behold, there is a place by Me' (Exod 33:21).
